description: This file defines the 'tlKeyword' class which manages keywords in the TestLink test management system. It handles database interactions, XML/CSV serialization, validation, and encapsulates logic related to keywords such as creation, update, deletion, and existence checks within the application.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: Class for managing keywords within TestLink, including database operations, serialization, validation, and XML/CSV export/import.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the keyword's properties with provided database ID, test project ID, name, and notes.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads the keyword data from the database into the object.

methods.name: readFromDBRow
methods.description: Populates the object properties from a database row.

methods.name: getReadFromDBQuery
methods.description: Constructs SQL query to fetch keyword(s) from the database.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Saves the keyword object into the database, either inserting or updating.

methods.name: checkKeyword
methods.description: Validates that the keyword name is unique and adheres to syntax rules.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the keyword and its associations from the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a keyword object by ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate multiple keywords by their IDs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to fetch all keywords matching criteria.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of the keyword's properties.

methods.name: checkKeywordName
methods.description: Validates syntax rules for a keyword name.

methods.name: doesKeywordExist
methods.description: Checks if a keyword exists for a given test project, optionally excluding a specific ID.

methods.name: getFormatDescriptionForXML
methods.description: Provides an XML format description for keyword serialization.

methods.name: writeToXML
methods.description: Serializes the keyword to XML format and appends to given XML string.

methods.name: toXMLString
methods.description: Returns the keyword as an XML string representation.

methods.name: readFromXML
methods.description: Loads keyword data from an XML string.

methods.name: readFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Populates the object from a SimpleXML element representing a keyword.

methods.name: getFormatDescriptionForCSV
methods.description: Provides format description for CSV serialization.

methods.name: writeToCSV
methods.description: Serializes the keyword to CSV format.

methods.name: readFromCSV
methods.description: Populates the keyword object from CSV data.

methods.name: getSimpleSet
methods.description: Retrieves a simplified set of keywords from the database with optional filters.
